name: perf_crash_cub_nosedown_magenta
what: ROW 15, IS THE BLUE SCREEN THE PAGE SHOWING THROUGH? (23 Nov; the Deform Coordinator's test.) The page's background is a pale sky blue (style.css: html, body { background: #cfe0ec }). crash_cub_nosedown with that background set to MAGENTA before the take-off: if the screen goes magenta at the impact, the canvas is not being shown and the page is - the draw guard's held frames (shader_warm.js guard, aa.hold: a frame whose draw waits for a program is not resolved onto the canvas). Run with --screencast.

steps.name: the page's background magenta
steps.js: (() => { document.documentElement.style.background = '#ff00ff'; document.body.style.background = '#ff00ff'; const G = window.FLYDIY_GUARD; return 'page background magenta; guard ' + (G ? JSON.stringify(G.stats && { held: G.stats.held, compiles: G.stats.compiles, ready: G.stats.ready, timedOut: G.stats.timedOut }) : 'absent'); })()

steps.name: the nose down, into the ground
steps.js: (() => { const P = window.FLIGHT_PROBE; P.setManual(true, 'rig'); const I = P.input(); if (window.__NOSE) clearInterval(window.__NOSE); let n = 0; window.__NOSE = setInterval(() => { try { I.setAxis('pitch', -1); if (++n > 1500 || P.over()) clearInterval(window.__NOSE); } catch (e) { clearInterval(window.__NOSE); } }, 16); I.setAxis('pitch', -1); return 'manual ' + P.manual() + ', the stick HELD forward (pitch axis ' + I.axis('pitch') + '), agl ' + (+P.agl()).toFixed(1); })()

steps.name: the guard's count
steps.js: (() => { const G = window.FLYDIY_GUARD, A = window.FLYDIY_AA; return 'guard ' + (G ? JSON.stringify({ held: G.stats.held, compiles: G.stats.compiles, ready: G.stats.ready, timedOut: G.stats.timedOut, heldNow: G.heldNow, what: (G.stats.what || []).slice(0, 40) }) : 'absent') + ' | frames the AA stage held: ' + (A && A.held ? A.held() : 'n/a'); })()
